title: BanzaConformanceProfileRegistry
description: Structure of the normative conformance-profile registry (contracts/production/conformance-profiles.production.json), which defines what each profile L0–L4 requires. A profile confers nothing: no certification, no admission, no authorisation. Levels denote conformance readiness only.
_authority: This schema constrains the registry's shape. The registry itself is the authority on profile content. No implementation code defines either.

cumulative.description: True when each profile includes the requirements of the profiles it lists in `includes`. The obligation at a level is the transitive closure over `includes`, never a directory concatenation.

includes.description: Profiles whose requirements this profile also carries. The remaining required_* members are this level's INCREMENT.

required_invariants.description: Invariant identifiers. Every one MUST exist in contracts/invariants.json.

required_vector_cases.description: Which cases of a required vector file this profile must satisfy. Either the string "ALL", or the explicit list of case ids. Listing a file under required_vectors states that it is in scope; this member states how much of it is, which is not the same question.

awarded_by_sandbox_runner.description: Whether a single-implementation conformance run can award this level. False where the level needs evidence a single implementation cannot produce.

not_required.description: What this level explicitly does NOT require. Stating this is not decoration: an implementer who cannot tell where a level stops will implement more than the level asks, and a level that only lists obligations cannot be scoped.

profile_parameterized.description: True when the level's additional requirements are supplied by an external profile the implementation selects, rather than by a universal artifact set. A parameterized profile MUST carry `external_profile`.

external_profile.description: How a parameterized level is claimed and demonstrated. Present exactly when profile_parameterized is true.

result_without_a_selected_profile.description: The per-level result when no external profile is selected. Drawn from the vocabulary published in contracts/production/conformance-report.production.schema.json; it MUST NOT be `pass`, or satisfying a lower level would silently satisfy this one.

published_profiles.description: Concrete external-interoperability profiles published for this level. An empty array is a truthful statement that none exists, not a placeholder to be filled with an example.
